summary: Return a deterministic risk classification before implementation
description: Classify changed paths and semantics before planning so approval gates can bind to a recorded risk level. This fixture is local-only and contains no credentials or customer data.
acceptanceCriteria: Every changed path maps to exactly one risk level of low, medium, high, or critical.
The classification artifact records the rule ids that produced each level.
Unknown semantics produce risk level unknown and block the workflow.
No approval is granted before the classification artifact exists.
